body:
Independent REGISTRATION-SOURCE review of the answer_bank_successor layer on PR #502 of caribousun/focuschrist-website at exact head 80a27c371de79a6fc3837c4bc916b8cf2aab032c, against the working tree at ~/workspace/fcfix2/step1-release/repo/. Scope is registration-source only: finished_pixels is false in this scope and I reviewed no rendered pixels; the finished behavior of the registration mechanics (manifest, spans, restore/advance, binding composition, mutation rejection) is in scope and was verified with my own runs. Verdict: CONCUR. No blocking defect found.

1. MANIFEST AND SPANS (verified by my own recompute). The manifest's canonical hash (sorted-keys JSON, compact separators, SHA-256) recomputes to exactly the pinned SOURCE_SHA 2a2b55fcb06404702fe01df1e55f974f68e138bd04835e13313c9903fe25cebe. The manifest registers exactly three files, one span each, each a pure insertion (previous_b64 empty): ask.html +321 bytes at [9707, 10028), pioneers.html +321 bytes at [16265, 16586), pioneer-experience.js +399 bytes at [71012, 71411). For each file: the head bytes hash to the manifest's after_sha256 and the module's AFTER pin (ask.html 735ccd0d56d7931a651ec8c06759cc849e7895fa55311f8d9d7d6bb36b419612; pioneers.html b2b988d240a7d54b60b2d2701fde26f54fa6ca1b63261b3d7f7f9e89377a3bf5; pioneer-experience.js b1f6f02625377c9f28850e88d707c4e9837c0d6c183510463b65448294cfb9cb); the baseline copy bytes (pinned base 39a5379d tree) hash to the before_sha256 / BEFORE pin (4a5f73ee35fb5cd8d1a9d30109f7daf9f85f7e3913fb5e3cc012a996d6058db3; 57fe21dc3a92dde1b5c51cddcf872cabe62d1e88a7ec259fc135afaa80cb8b81; 229d4698dd9316af84047e295134636f77ed9965291c5444c03183fa54487593); removing exactly the registered span from the head bytes reproduces the baseline bytes byte-for-byte, and the file length deltas are exactly 321/321/399, so the spans are the candidate's insertions and nothing else. Placement matches the module's claim: in both HTML files the inserted four deferred answer-bank script tags (data, matcher, guards, lane, each ?v=20261023-answer-bank-1) sit immediately after the reviewed-ask-knowledge.js tag, and in pioneer-experience.js the guarded FocusChristAnswerBankLane.serveDisclosure branch sits at the top of researchDisclosure directly after its pre-existing pending-state guard.

2. FAIL-CLOSED MECHANICS (my own runs). I ran tools/test_answer_bank_successor.py myself: 12 tests, all pass. The suite covers exact round trips (fixture and real candidate), the full historical map round trip through the composed chain, wrong-route passthrough, wrong-layer manifest rejection, the PENDING pin blocking even with complete fixture scopes, six real-page mutations on ask.html (duplicated, truncated, altered-inside, altered-older-layer, unrelated-append, removed) each rejected at check() and passed through unstripped at restore(), changed span manifest and changed predecessor pin rejected, missing files rejected, missing rendered slots blocking with the MISSING message, eleven tampered review-record variants rejected even when resealed, and a tampered capture plus a path-escape evidence path rejected. I ran nine additional probes of my own against the real tree and all passed: advance() passes through unchanged a near-miss predecessor (one older-region byte flipped in the BEFORE bytes), the AFTER bytes, and BEFORE bytes with the byte immediately before the insertion point flipped; restore() passes through unchanged AFTER bytes with one byte flipped inside the inserted span, the BEFORE bytes, cross-file inputs (ask bytes under the pioneers route and vice versa), and AFTER bytes with the span duplicated at a different location (offset 0). The module's check() on the real tree blocks with 'Answer bank successor finished review PENDING', the designed state.

3. BINDING COMPOSITION (my own diff against the baseline copy). The full-tree diff between the baseline copy and the release tree shows the registration adds docs/answer-bank-successor/ (manifest, reviews, README), tools/answer_bank_successor.py, and tools/test_answer_bank_successor.py, and touches exactly tools/continue_motion_binding.py and tools/test_continue_motion_binding.py among chain files. The binding diff is composition-only: restore_bank is wired innermost on restore (applied first, inside restore_hand) and advance_bank outermost on advance (applied last, wrapping advance_hand in both return paths), check_bank(root) is appended to check(), and the binding test has the one matching composition line. MAP_SHA (010f24f44c70beaab3dbfe2b92832cdc28adbb79343dcb34c144191154f4312a) and the motion APPROVED_REVIEWS pin are byte-identical to baseline; docs/continue-motion/predecessors.json, docs/continue-motion/reviews.json, and every earlier successor module, manifest, and review record are byte-identical to baseline. No earlier layer, map, or review hash was re-pinned. The binding CLI on the real tree blocks with exactly 'Continue motion gate BLOCKED: Answer bank successor finished review PENDING'. The binding test suite runs 13 tests with 2 errors (test_all_six_existing_delivery_context_records, test_display_review_evidence_including_page_snapshots); I ran the identical suite on the untouched baseline and got the identical two errors, so they are pre-existing partial-checkout scope artifacts, not effects of this layer; the other 11 pass in both trees, and the bank suite's composed round trip reproduces every motion-map file's before pin, including ask.html.

4. PENDING HONESTY. The shipped reviews.json contains exactly {files (the AFTER map), layer, required_reviewers [Jeff], source_sha256 (the manifest pin), status PENDING} and no registration_review, rendered_evidence, or rendered_review keys; the module ships APPROVED_REVIEWS = None. The suite's shipped-record truthfulness test genuinely asserts this real state: it parses the shipped reviews.json, asserts PENDING status, the absence of all three scope keys, the required reviewers, the source pin, and files equal to the real AFTER map, and greps the shipped module source for the literal 'APPROVED_REVIEWS = None' and the pinned SOURCE_SHA line. It asserts what it claims.

5. NO OVERREACH. The registration covers only the three insertion spans in the three pinned files; the module's manifest loader enforces exactly that file set and restore/advance pass any other name through unchanged. The other seven candidate files (answer-bank-data.js, answer-bank-matcher.js, answer-bank-guards.js, answer-bank-lane.js, study-intelligence-v3.js, ask-question-contracts.json, docs/ask-surface-registry.md) are not registered here and ride the normal PR review (my J-2026-10-23-047), CI, and the remaining scopes. The README states this boundary honestly, including that J-047 is not this registration review.

BOOKKEEPING DELTA THIS REVIEW AUTHORIZES, stated precisely. The integrator's bookkeeping delta for PR #502 may add exactly one object to docs/answer-bank-successor/reviews.json, a registration_review in the field shape tools/answer_bank_successor.py check() requires, carrying these values from this review: reviewer 'Jeff'; review_id 'J-2026-10-23-048'; scope 'registration-source'; decision 'CONCUR'; finished_pixels false; finished_behavior true; files equal to the AFTER map {ask.html: 735ccd0d56d7931a651ec8c06759cc849e7895fa55311f8d9d7d6bb36b419612, pioneers.html: b2b988d240a7d54b60b2d2701fde26f54fa6ca1b63261b3d7f7f9e89377a3bf5, pioneer-experience.js: b1f6f02625377c9f28850e88d707c4e9837c0d6c183510463b65448294cfb9cb}; and evidence {path: the in-repo path where the integrator places this exact J-2026-10-23-048 review file under docs/answer-bank-successor/, sha256: the SHA-256 of this file's exact bytes}. A date and a status of 'CONCUR' may ride along per the commission-hand precedent (J-2026-10-23-020's recorded shape). Nothing else may be recorded from this review: rendered_evidence and rendered_review remain unrecorded until Merlin's rendered collection at this head and my separate rendered review exist; the record's status stays PENDING and APPROVED_REVIEWS stays None until all three scopes are complete and the integrator pins the final canonical reviews hash in a later delta that itself gets a bookkeeping review. This review does not authorize changing manifest.json, the module's SOURCE_SHA/BEFORE/AFTER pins, docs/continue-motion/predecessors.json, the motion review record, or any earlier layer.
